entities.summary: Bakhyt Abdirakhmanuly Sarsekbayev is a Kazakh amateur boxer who won gold at the 2008 Summer Olympics at Welterweight, and won gold medal at the 2006 Asian Games at Welterweight, and won bronze at the 2002 Asian Games at Light Welterweight.
